'''Wamka Pol''' was one of the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gud/Legends|guds]] in the [[Gungan religion|religion]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Being the [[Deity/Legends|god]] of games, Wamka Pol was one of the less serious deities in the pantheon alongside [[Kobble]], the goddess of good [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and [[Nododo]], god of trickery. Like the other guds, Wamka Pol resided in the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ossorus]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kobble was mentioned in the Gungan Databank in the [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] edition of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
